inputs.label: Wipeout Pure PSP disc image (UCUS-98612, v2.00)
inputs.help: A disc image dumped from your own Wipeout Pure, US Greatest Hits edition (UCUS-98612, version 2.00), as .iso. Any file name works. Other editions and regions are refused.

steps.text: Open Wipeout Pure VR from Library > Unknown Sources. It checks the disc image, sets the game up and starts. Keep Wi-Fi on: the first start downloads an HD texture pack of about 450 MB. If the image is refused, import/SETUP-ERROR.txt says why.

notes: An empty files/no-hd-textures created before the first start skips the HD texture download. QGPUI has no optional steps yet, so that marker (shell touch /sdcard/Android/data/online.portroyale.wipeoutpurevr/files/no-hd-textures) is not added; it would also have to come before the launch step, which may itself start the download. Saves and settings live in files/; uninstalling the app deletes them.
